# Remote-expert orchestration

Pool profiles for the distributed swarm. Each profile bundles whether to spawn the backend sidecar, the starter expert count and the inference mixing strategy, so new variants are entries, not new flags. The expert block types a pool member can wrap are the feedforward experts (the ``dense`` registry).

Namespace: ``registry.namespace("orchestration")``, declared in ``praxis.orchestration`` (6 entries)

Selected with ``--orchestration-type`` (default: ``none``).

## `frontend_only`

No baseline experts: the pool mixes, by vote, only the experts that join from the
frontend.

## `none`

Disabled. No remote-expert pool, the common case.

## `swarm`

An in-process pool of 4 tiny experts, joinable from the web Stage tab, mixed at
inference by the CALM-style expert vote.

## `swarm_mean`

swarm mixed by a plain mean of the expert outputs instead of a vote.

## `swarm_sidecar`

swarm plus a spawned Node sidecar of browser-math experts, which join the pool as extra
peers.

## `swarm_wave`

swarm mixed by a standing wave over the peer index, so peers compose by interference
rather than a flat average.
